description: "An invented image-processing pipeline: a Kafka topic buffers uploads while HPA starts workers. The saved burst shows backlog building, replicas becoming ready and the backlog draining within ten simulated seconds. This teaching model explicitly uses a 1 s sync, 1 s metric window, 2 s startup and 30 s downscale stabilization; these are not Kubernetes defaults. Open a worker’s Live details for replica history."
